result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-rendered, but one clear data-rendering defect stands out: the Smash Bros Burgers card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee. No other significant visual breakage was found; the clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut pizza card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The delivery fee for 'Smash Bros Burgers' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel displays as '€NaN delivery', a raw failed number-formatting value exposed to users. Neighboring cards show valid fees (€0.90, €1.90).
issues.suggestion: Guard the price formatter against null/undefined/non-numeric fee values. Show a fallback (e.g., hide the fee line, or show 'Delivery fee unavailable' or 'Free delivery' when appropriate) instead of rendering NaN, and check the upstream data for this restaurant.
